title: 5e-1: health finding model + first biomarker
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

The foundational health finding model that all biomarkers produce into. Define the HealthFinding struct (biomarker kind, target file/symbol/component, severity advisory/informational, confidence, provenance, metric value, threshold, human-readable detail). Create DB migration for health_findings table. Integrate health findings with the existing waiver mechanism from the constraint system. Implement one biomarker end-to-end (nested_complexity) to prove the full pipeline: parse → compute finding → store → query → waive.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] HealthFinding struct with BiomarkerKind enum, target granularity (file/symbol/component), severity (advisory/informational only — never blocking), confidence, provenance
- [ ] DB migration: health_findings table in the ephemeral partition
- [ ] Health findings reuse the constraint waiver mechanism — a waived health finding is excluded from score derivation but still visible in reports
- [ ] nested_complexity biomarker implemented: emits advisory findings for functions exceeding a nesting depth threshold
- [ ] Pipeline integration: health findings computed during parse and stored in DB
- [ ] Health findings queryable (internal API, not MCP tool yet)
- [ ] Tests: finding model creation, nested_complexity threshold logic, waiver exclusion

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately"
